source_comparison.policy: Same host, independent baseline/candidate normal builds and fresh owned service/database lifecycle per arm; original full native k6 matrix, five reversed rounds, oracle before each trial. Instrumentation disabled.

source_blob_verification.method: SHA256 checked against git show of exact measured candidate/baseline commits, avoiding checkout line-ending differences.

verdict: Inconclusive for optimization, regression or catalog service-capacity claims. Full campaign and recorded-native-sample reconciliation completed; all failures, dropped offers and telemetry omissions are retained.

scope.mix: 50% List, 40% Get, 10% Search among started iterations
scope.protocol: Actual gRPC over loopback; generator, gateways and durable database co-located on one hosted VM.

artifact.name: catalog-compare-39769299508
artifact.zip_hash_policy: Digest is GitHub API metadata; local gh download extracted it. Extracted receipt hashes and gzip CRC/content were independently checked.

limitations: No successful-request latency is invented for the 37 absent native status-zero duration samples.
Recorded successful-RPC tails exclude failures, dropped offers, connection and validation duration.
Native iteration duration and validation-group duration remain separately retained.
Planned rate*duration offers differ from native actual started+dropped; both are retained.
The co-located fixed-64-VU setup did not sustain high offered rates; limiting component is not isolated.
Earlier native profiling used a different host and instrumented binary and is diagnostic only.
Role CPU samples are first-to-last observed ticks per PID and role RSS is sampled maximum single-process RSS, not peak tree or isolated process cost.
Two build totals across heterogeneous workloads are accounting totals, not pooled performance percentiles or a throughput comparison.
The full eleven-service storefront or six-service autoscaling was not measured.
The desired 1200RPS/186-to-104ms and 52% six-service throughput claims remain unverified.
post_measurement_driver_change: The Python result mapper now exposes native_status_zero_count and native_duration_gap after each k6 trial. Both mappings were checked against all 1,086 retained native summaries; generation, workload, timing and product code are unchanged.
